study type: Comparative cross-sectional study with a prospective element for threatened preterm labour
exposure: Labour status (term non-labour, term labour, preterm non-labour)
Threatened preterm labour with different delivery outcomes (preterm delivery, term delivery)
outcome: Urinary prostaglandin metabolites (PGE2, PGF2a, PGD2, PGI2, 8-isoprostane, and 147 other eicosanoids)
cohort: Pregnant individuals (n=183 overall) recruited into groups: term non-labour (n=32), term labour (n=49), preterm non-labour controls (n=15), threatened preterm labour with preterm delivery (n=43), and threatened preterm labour with term delivery (n=44).
finding: At term, PGF2a and PGE2/PGF2a metabolites increased with labour, but no changes were observed prior to labour onset; PGI2 metabolite was lower in individuals with threatened preterm labour who delivered preterm compared to those who delivered at term, though no prostaglandins were identified as useful predictors for term or preterm labour.
cross-section timing: At term non-labour, term labour, preterm non-labour, and during threatened preterm labour.
